name: Reimu's Treasure
description: Place a “Yin-Yang Orb” on a select open market boosting the profit rate of it by x100 and x50 to the open markets surrounding them.

name: Reimu's Seal
description: Shut down a select open market for 2 turns, leave a “Talisman” on that open market, cannot target an open market w/ “Talisman.

name: Marisa's Magic
description: Every time you have one more hundred thousand in your possession, you gain a level in your “magician” meter” (Max 10). Every 2 levels give you different stacking mandatory effects...

name: Marisa's Mushrooms
description: Sacrifice an open market and “eat a mushroom” with stacking effects correlating to the turn number.

name: Mystia's Gain
description: Gain $5000. If you have another market in play, gain $2500 instead.

name: Kogasa's Trickery
description: Target 1 of your opponent's markets, place a Kogasa on that market. Gain profits from that market instead at the end of your turn. You can't target markets with a Kogasa token

name: Wriggle's Destruct
description: Target 1 of your opponent's markets and remove it out of play

name: Keine's Detention
description: Any market on this tile is removed from play at the end of your turn. Return that market at the begining of your next turn. You can't target the same tile previously selected.'

name: Moriya's Wrath
description: Target all of a player's market and steal everybody's profits, then take out the market with the highest amount of profit

name: The Hifuu Club Special
description: If all types of markets are in play at the end of the turn, target an open market you control and the opponent controls. Targeted markets become a random market of that type at a higher type.
